title: Massillon Museum

services.name: 4-hour rental
services.desc: The Massillon Museum welcomes everyone!Individuals, friends, and families can wander through the exhibitions on their own. Children ages 15 and younger must be accompanied by an adult at all times. For access to the Sensory Room, one member of the party must be at least 18 years of age. Groups may wish to arrange in advance for a guided tour. Plan for an hour in the galleries, plus time to shop in OHregionalities. The Massillon Museum is open Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday from 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Thursday from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., and Sunday from 2:00 to 5:00 p.m. The Museum is closed on Mondays and most major holidays. services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Call today to reserve Massillon Museum for your next event! Conveniently located in downtown Massillon, MassMu offers unique spaces to accommodate groups of various sizes and needs. We are an art and history museum offering free admission, committed to community collaborations and accessibility. We care for more than 100,000 items in our permanent collection, and change exhibitions in our galleries several times a year. The Museum is managed by a small staff of professionals with the additional support of over 125 volunteers. All funds from the Museum facility rentals help support our operating costs.
